summary: Verified the 3 features in the review_request. Backend: photo ZIP export endpoint returns 200 + valid ZIP (auth required, 401 unauth, 404 invalid job) — 3/4 backend tests pass. CRITICAL BUG FOUND: the new pole_markup_photos field is NOT in the backend Pole/PoleUpdate Pydantic models, so any data sent from the new 'Pole Mark Ups' section in PoleForm.jsx is silently dropped by FastAPI and never persisted. The frontend UI for both new features works (Photos button is green, between OCALC and ASE, downloads a real ZIP; Pole Mark Ups section heading + General Pole Photos label + PhotoMarkupEditor render on the Add Pole page).

critical.issue: Pole / PoleUpdate Pydantic models in /app/backend/models/pole.py do NOT include the pole_markup_photos field. The PoleForm.jsx sends pole_markup_photos in the create/update payload, but FastAPI's strict Pydantic validation drops the field before insert. Round-trip test confirms field is missing from GET /api/poles/{id} response (only hoa_markup_photos is present). services/helpers.py:147 already references pole.get('pole_markup_photos') for ZIP export, but data will never be there.

rca of the issue: Root cause for pole_markup_photos missing in persistence: FastAPI uses Pydantic to validate request bodies against PoleBase (POST) and PoleUpdate (PUT). Both classes in /app/backend/models/pole.py omit pole_markup_photos. By default Pydantic discards unknown fields silently, so when the frontend POSTs {... pole_markup_photos: [...]} the field never reaches the MongoDB insert. Fix: add pole_markup_photos: Optional[List[str]] = [] to PoleBase (line ~59) and Optional[List[str]] = None to PoleUpdate (line ~108). After that, helpers.pole_photo_items() will pick it up and the ZIP export will include Pole_Markup files.
